comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: three archetypes reads fine, but nothing here says how often a retest entry just keeps going through the level. that one number decides whether the first model works, and the post never shows it.

replies.author: BullSnipper
replies.body: I am sorry, I can't reveal my proprietary trading logic.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: no need to share the logic. the one check I'd run on a learner like that: does each update only see trades that closed before the next entry? overlapping trades can leak the future into it quietly.

replies.author: BullSnipper
replies.body: Yes, it only sees the trade that closed before the next trade. It is categorized by each trading pair. So EURUSD trade outcome does not leak into GBPUSD trade outcome. They are two distinct trading buckets.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: then it's clean on that front. the one thing I'd still watch: EURUSD and GBPUSD move together a lot of days, so two separate buckets can end up learning the same lesson from the same move and look like twice the evidence.

replies.author: BullSnipper
replies.body: I do have a correlation and exposure filter implementation for that.
